data.description: When a thanatotic titan damages a creature capable of casting divine spells, that creature must make a DC %1 Will save or be unable to cast any divine spells for 1d4 rounds and be shaken.  If the save is successful, the creature struck is merely shaken for 1 round.  A thanatotic titan's attacks are treated as epic and evil for the purposes of overcoming damage reduction.
data.name: Godslayer
